g.text: Tag = device ID + suffix. Light tags show group-number (e.g. 38-03 = DP-38-03), numbered top to bottom, then left to right.
Same color = same device (multiple instances). Dark gray tags = single-instance devices.
Lights (103 in the CAD: 68 recessed, 3 stars, 32 post)

DP-39 Bonus, multiplier and shoot-again lights: 8
